messages.app.hotkeys_status: Show, capture, copy+save, sync, copy-buffer, group, and per-clip shortcuts with modifiers or function keys are registered as system hotkeys. Use Win/Super in a shortcut to include the Windows/logo key. Built-in Ditto behavior: Enter copies, Shift+Enter copies plain text, Ctrl+1-0 copies the first ten, Ctrl+Shift+1-0 copies the first ten as plain text, Space/Ctrl-click/middle-click toggles multi-select, Ctrl+F2 compares text, Alt+C clears filters, F3 opens details, F5 refreshes, right-click opens the menu.
